The ad blocker for Windows itself: point at something Windows added without asking, and it goes away. Everything it took can be brought back.

Nothing leaves this PC unless you ask an AI to explain an entry - and then only the name of the setting.

Rule_Question_Advertising ID: Stop apps using your advertising ID?
Rule_Detail_Advertising ID: Apps no longer read the per-user id that ties ads across them.
Rule_Question_Finish setup prompts: Stop the "finish setting up your device" screen?
Rule_Detail_Finish setup prompts: Windows no longer interrupts you with setup suggestions after signing in.
Rule_Question_Tips and suggestions: Stop tips and suggestions in Settings?
Rule_Detail_Tips and suggestions: Windows stops suggesting apps and features you did not ask about.
Rule_Detail_Start button: Everything {app} knows about, in one list.
Rule_Detail_Copilot: The app is uninstalled and its taskbar icon goes with it. The Store has it back any time.
Rule_Question_Task view button: Remove the Task View button from the taskbar?
Rule_Detail_Task view button: The button disappears. Win+Tab keeps working.
Rule_Question_Taskbar search: Remove the search box from the taskbar?
Rule_Detail_Taskbar search: The box disappears. Search still opens with the Start menu or Win+S.
Rule_Question_Widgets button: Remove the Widgets button from the taskbar?
Rule_Detail_Widgets button: The button and its hover panel disappear.
Rule_Question_Chat button: Remove the Chat button from the taskbar?
Rule_Detail_Chat button: The button disappears. Teams stays installed.
Rule_Question_Start menu suggestions: Remove the recommended section from the Start menu?
Rule_Detail_Start menu suggestions: Start stops suggesting files and apps you did not pin yourself.
Rule_Question_Web results in search: Remove web results from Windows search?
Rule_Detail_Web results in search: Search only looks on this PC. Your browser is untouched.
Rule_Question_Explorer OneDrive banner: Stop the OneDrive ads in File Explorer?
Rule_Detail_Explorer OneDrive banner: The blue "get more storage" strip above your files disappears.
Rule_Question_Settings app suggestions: Stop the account and Office banners in Settings?
Rule_Detail_Settings app suggestions: The Settings app stops advertising Microsoft 365 and account upgrades.
Rule_Question_What's new after updates: Stop the welcome screen after every update?
Rule_Detail_What's new after updates: Windows stops opening a full-screen tour once an update is installed.
Rule_Question_Apps installing themselves: Stop Windows installing suggested apps on its own?
Rule_Detail_Apps installing themselves: No more games and trials appearing in Start that you never asked for.
Rule_Question_Lock screen ads: Stop the ads on the lock screen?
Rule_Detail_Lock screen ads: The picture stays, the "like what you see" text and its offers go.
Rule_Question_Lock screen slideshow: Stop the lock screen cycling through pictures?
Rule_Detail_Lock screen slideshow: One picture stays instead of a slideshow of your own photos.
Rule_Question_Tailored experiences: Stop Microsoft tailoring tips to your diagnostic data?
Rule_Detail_Tailored experiences: Windows stops turning what it measures about you into suggestions.
Rule_Question_App launch tracking: Stop Windows recording which apps you open?
Rule_Detail_App launch tracking: Start stops ranking your apps by how often you used them.
Rule_Question_Location for apps: Turn off the location service for apps?
Rule_Detail_Location for apps: Apps can no longer ask Windows where this PC is.
Rule_Question_Online speech recognition: Stop sending your voice to Microsoft?
Rule_Detail_Online speech recognition: Dictation falls back to the recognition that runs on this PC.
Rule_Question_Click To Do: Turn off the Click To Do overlay?
Rule_Detail_Click To Do: Win+Click stops opening the AI panel over whatever is on screen.
Rule_Question_Phone panel in Start: Remove the phone panel from the Start menu?
Rule_Detail_Phone panel in Start: The column on the right side of Start disappears.
Rule_Question_Snap layouts on hover: Stop the layout box popping up over the maximize button?
Rule_Detail_Snap layouts on hover: The flyout goes. Win+Arrow and dragging to the edge keep working.
Rule_Question_Game recording in the back: Stop Xbox recording your games in the background?
Rule_Detail_Game recording in the backgr: Nothing is captured until you press record yourself.
Rule_Question_Gallery in Explorer: Remove Gallery from the File Explorer sidebar?
Rule_Detail_Gallery in Explorer: The entry goes. Your pictures stay exactly where they are.
Rule_Question_Explorer opens Home: Open File Explorer on This PC instead of Home?
Rule_Detail_Explorer opens Home: Explorer starts on your drives rather than on recommended files.
Rule_Question_Spotlight icon on the desk: Remove the Spotlight icon from the desktop?
Rule_Detail_Spotlight icon on the deskto: The "learn about this picture" icon goes. The wallpaper keeps changing.
Rule_Question_Recycle Bin on the desktop: Remove the Recycle Bin from the desktop?
Rule_Detail_Recycle Bin on the desktop: The icon goes. Deleted files still land there and Explorer still opens it.
Rule_Question_Suggested notifications: Stop Windows suggesting things through notifications?
Rule_Detail_Suggested notifications: The toasts that advertise features stop. Your apps keep notifying you.
Rule_Question_Show more options: Bring back the full right-click menu?
Rule_Detail_Show more options: Every entry is on the first menu again, so nothing hides behind a second click.
Rule_Question_Recall: Stop Windows Recall from being switched on?
Rule_Detail_Recall: The AI that screenshots everything you do can no longer be enabled on this PC.
Rule_Question_Copilot everywhere: Turn Copilot off for this account?
Rule_Detail_Copilot everywhere: A policy instead of an uninstall: Copilot stays installed and stops opening at all.
Rule_Question_Activity history: Stop Windows collecting what you did?
Rule_Detail_Activity history: No more list of apps opened and files used behind the Timeline.
Rule_Question_Diagnostic data: Send Microsoft as little diagnostic data as Windows allows?
Rule_Detail_Diagnostic data: Telemetry drops to the required minimum. It cannot be switched off entirely.
Rule_Detail_Lock screen: Waking the PC goes straight to the sign-in box.
Rule_Question_Edge sign-in prompt: Stop Edge asking you to sign in?
Rule_Detail_Edge sign-in prompt: Edge stops pushing a Microsoft account on every start.
Rule_Question_Edge default browser naggi: Stop Edge asking to be your default browser?
Rule_Detail_Edge default browser nagging: The banner and the full-screen prompt both stop appearing.
Rule_Question_Edge new tab clutter: Clear the shortcuts off the Edge new tab page?
Rule_Detail_Edge new tab clutter: MSN, Office and the other preset tiles disappear.
Rule_Question_Edge shopping sidebar: Turn off the Edge shopping assistant?
Rule_Detail_Edge shopping sidebar: No more coupon and price-comparison popups while you shop.
Rule_Detail_Edge welcome page: Edge stops opening a tour after every install and update.
Rule_Question_Edge running in the backgr: Stop Edge staying in memory after you close it?
Rule_Detail_Edge running in the backgrou: Startup Boost goes. Edge opens a moment slower but is really gone when closed.
Rule_Detail_Edge sidebar: The Discover and tools column on the right disappears.
Rule_Name_Restart while you are signed i: Restart while you are signed in
Rule_Question_Restart while you are sign: Stop Windows rebooting on its own to finish an update?
Rule_Detail_Restart while you are signed: Updates wait for you to restart instead of choosing a moment themselves.
Rule_Question_Drivers from Windows Updat: Leave drivers out of Windows Update?
Rule_Detail_Drivers from Windows Update: A working driver is no longer replaced behind your back.
Rule_Question_Search suggestions: Stop the search box suggesting things you never typed?
Rule_Detail_Search suggestions: The box only answers what you type instead of filling itself with offers.
Rule_Question_News and interests: Remove News and interests from the taskbar?
Rule_Detail_News and interests: The weather strip and the headline panel behind it disappear.
Rule_Question_Meet Now button: Remove the Meet Now button from the tray?
Rule_Detail_Meet Now button: The Skype call icon next to the clock goes. Skype stays installed.
Rule_Question_Spotlight on the lock scre: Keep your own lock screen picture instead of Microsoft's?
Rule_Detail_Spotlight on the lock screen: Windows stops fetching a new picture every day, and the offers on it go with it.
Rule_Detail_Narrator online services: The screen reader speaks with the voices on this PC and sends nothing away.
Rule_Question_Edge collections: Remove the Collections button from Edge?
Rule_Detail_Edge collections: The clipboard icon in the toolbar and its panel disappear.
Rule_Question_Edge gamer mode: Turn off the Edge games panel?
Rule_Detail_Edge gamer mode: The controller icon and the games Edge suggests in it go.
Rule_Question_Edge importing on every st: Stop Edge importing from your other browser on every start?
Rule_Detail_Edge importing on every star: Edge stops copying tabs and favourites from Chrome behind your back.
Rule_Question_Edge quick links: Remove the quick links from the Edge new tab page?
Rule_Detail_Edge quick links: The row of sites Edge thinks you want disappears.
Rule_Question_Edge feedback: Remove the feedback button from Edge?
Rule_Detail_Edge feedback: The smiley in the menu and the survey popups both go.
